purpose: Determine whether the Stage-6R clean-0.90 matched-bit advantage is stable across activities and session lengths rather than being dominated by the long 2023 activity.

diagnostic_checks.no_single_activity_dependency: All leave-one-activity-out paired-savings 95 percent lower bounds are above zero.
diagnostic_checks.activity_macro_direction: Equal-activity macro and scene-weighted savings have the same sign.
diagnostic_checks.short_session_break_even: Report the shortest registered cold-start session length whose paired-savings 95 percent lower bound is above zero.

claim_boundary: This diagnostic reuses workpoints selected on the same four development activities and is not confirmatory evidence.
Link Monte Carlo intervals do not represent a population interval over unseen activities.
Leave-one-activity-out here removes an activity from evaluation aggregation; it does not reselect the reliability workpoint.
Repeated calibration in short sessions is deliberately conservative and does not refit the frozen codebook.
No new Final signal values may be accessed.
